stories.title: Game 2 Recap — Cubs Offense Pours It On in D.C.
stories.angle: Cubs put up a monster offensive game in Game 2 at Nationals Park. Bregman continued his dominant series, Swanson homered, Peterson outpitched his 6.09 ERA through five innings, and Jacob Webb was the bullpen hero per Bleed Cubbie Blue. Lead with the performers — NOT the final score per has_score=False insight. Series finale today at 3:05 PM CT.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Bregman and Swanson went to work again last night.

David Peterson outpitched his 6.09 ERA through five. Jacob Webb slammed the door. Cubs offense? Relentless.

Series finale today at Nationals Park. 3:05 PM CT.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong — WAR 7.5, NL MVP Frontrunner
